noDependencies: No dependencies. This module can be built at any time.

external.campaignIdColumns: Campaign link on leads and opportunities

products.title: Products & Price Books
products.summary: One product catalog shared with the website shop, priced per country and currency.
products.description: Products are synced from the website marketplace catalog, so a product keeps the same SKU in the shop, in quotes and in the CRM. Price books hold the list price of each product per country and currency (BRL, USD, EUR, CNY). Reps add products from the right price book to an opportunity as line items, and the opportunity amount is then calculated from those lines instead of typed by hand.

capabilities.catalogSync: Scheduled sync of products, SKUs, families and units from the website marketplace catalog
capabilities.priceBooks: Price books per country and currency, with a standard book and regional books
capabilities.lineItems: Opportunity line items with quantity, unit price and discount; the amount is calculated from the lines
capabilities.multiCurrency: Each opportunity is priced from a price book in its own currency
capabilities.activeFlag: Retired products stay on past deals but can no longer be added to new ones

dependencies.websiteCatalogApi: A read API on the website marketplace that exposes products by SKU.
dependencies.opportunityLineItems: A crm_opportunity_line_items table linking opportunities to price book entries.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.summary: Branded quotes built from an opportunity, with approval when discounts run high.
quotes.description: A rep creates a quote from an opportunity. Its line items come from the price book, and the rep sets discounts, taxes and a validity date. The quote produces a branded PDF in the customer's language. When a discount goes above the configured threshold, the quote goes to approval before it can be sent. A quote that started as a website RFQ keeps the RFQ reference, so the request, the quote and the deal stay linked.

capabilities.fromOpportunity: Create a quote from an opportunity, copying its account, contact and line items
capabilities.pricing: Line discounts, header discount, taxes and a validity date
capabilities.pdf: Branded PDF in the customer's language, ready to email
capabilities.approvalThreshold: Discounts above the threshold require approval before sending
capabilities.rfqLink: Keeps the website RFQ reference from the original request
capabilities.versions: Several versions per opportunity, with one marked as the synced quote

dependencies.products: Line items and prices come from products and price books.
dependencies.approvals: Discounts above the threshold are routed through an approval policy.

orders.title: Orders
orders.summary: Orders created from won deals and accepted quotes, handed off to the ERP.
orders.description: When an opportunity is Closed Won or a quote is accepted, an order is created with the agreed lines, prices and delivery terms. The order tracks its fulfilment status (draft, confirmed, in production, shipped, delivered) and is sent to the ERP, which becomes the system of record for invoicing. Sales can follow delivery without leaving the account.

capabilities.fromClosedWon: Create an order automatically when an opportunity is Closed Won
capabilities.fromQuote: Convert an accepted quote into an order with the same lines and prices
capabilities.fulfilment: Fulfilment status from draft to delivered, with dates per step
capabilities.erpHandoff: Send confirmed orders to the ERP and store the ERP order number
capabilities.accountHistory: Order history on the account and contact record pages

dependencies.quotes: Orders inherit lines, prices and terms from the accepted quote.
dependencies.erpIntegration: The ERP receives confirmed orders and reports their status back.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.summary: Trade shows, digital and email campaigns, with attribution and ROI.
campaigns.description: Campaigns group the marketing actions that bring in business: trade shows, digital ads, webinars and email sends. Leads and contacts are added as members with a status (sent, responded, attended). Leads and opportunities record the campaign that sourced them, so the pipeline and won revenue of each campaign can be compared with its cost.

capabilities.types: Campaign types: trade show, digital, email, webinar and partner event
capabilities.members: Member lists of leads and contacts with a response status
capabilities.attribution: Primary campaign source on leads and opportunities
capabilities.costRoi: Budget, actual cost, pipeline generated and won revenue per campaign
capabilities.hierarchy: Parent campaigns that roll up several actions, such as one trade show season

dependencies.campaignIdColumns: A nullable campaign_id column on leads and opportunities, added without a breaking change.

email.title: Email
email.summary: Mailbox sync, templates, record-page sending and timeline logging, with a local-first cache.
email.description: Each user connects a 263 or simply mailbox today, with Microsoft 365 and Gmail OAuth planned through Integrations. Headers are cached in the browser and bodies or attachments load on demand. Known contacts and accounts are matched to senders, and composing from a contact or account page prefills the recipient and logs the sent email on the activity timeline. Localised templates and reply threading are available; received-email timeline logging, merge fields and last-contacted tracking remain planned.

capabilities.mailboxSync: Per-user 263/simply IMAP and SMTP, with OAuth mailbox providers planned
capabilities.templates: Local templates for record-page composing, with record merge fields planned
capabilities.sendFromRecord: Compose from contact or account records today; lead and opportunity pages planned
capabilities.autoLogging: Record-page sends logged on the activity timeline; received-email logging planned
capabilities.replyDetection: In-Reply-To threading on replies, with last-contacted tracking planned
capabilities.localCache: IndexedDB cache for headers, bodies, attachments and drafts
capabilities.integrations: Multi-account tags and encrypted credentials behind a thin protocol bridge

dependencies.integrations: Microsoft 365 and Gmail OAuth connections will use the planned integrations module.

reports.title: Reports & Dashboards
reports.summary: A report builder on CRM objects, with saved reports and team dashboards.
reports.description: Users build reports on leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities and activities. They choose the columns, add filters, group rows and add a chart. Reports can be saved, shared with a team or with everyone, and placed on dashboards. Every report respects the record visibility of the person viewing it.

capabilities.builder: Report builder with columns and filters on every CRM object
capabilities.grouping: Group by rows and columns with sums, averages and counts
capabilities.charts: Bar, line, funnel and donut charts in brand colors
capabilities.sharing: Private, team and public report folders
capabilities.dashboards: Custom dashboards per team made from saved reports
capabilities.export: CSV export that follows the viewer's record visibility

industry-news.title: Industry News
industry-news.summary: TrendRadar-style monitoring of hot lists and RSS feeds for the industries Oboya serves.
industry-news.description: Industry News gives the team one place to follow what is happening in horticulture, agriculture and adjacent markets. Administrators configure keyword groups, industries, regions and information sources in a graphical editor; a fetch collects headlines from Chinese hot lists and RSS feeds, matches them against those groups and keeps each story's rank history. Results appear as a weighted, filterable feed so reps can spot emerging topics before they reach the sales pipeline.

capabilities.sources: Hot-list and RSS source catalogue with one-click enablement and custom feeds
capabilities.keywords: Keyword groups with required, excluded and regular-expression words
capabilities.regions: Geographic keyword groups to focus the feed on a market
capabilities.ranking: TrendRadar-style weighting from rank, frequency and hotness
capabilities.freshness: Report modes and age filters that keep the feed current

forecasting.title: Forecasting
forecasting.summary: Forecasts by rep, team, company and period, measured against quotas.
forecasting.description: Forecasting rolls open opportunities up by close date into monthly and quarterly periods. It shows the forecast per rep, team and group company against each person's quota. The weighted pipeline (amount × probability) sits next to the forecast categories: pipeline, best case, commit and closed. All currencies are converted into one reporting currency.

capabilities.hierarchy: Forecast by rep, team, group company and period
capabilities.quotas: Quotas per user and period, with attainment
capabilities.weighted: Weighted pipeline from amount × stage probability
capabilities.categories: Commit, best case and pipeline categories that reps can adjust
capabilities.currencyRollup: Multi-currency rollup into one reporting currency

dependencies.reports: Forecast views reuse the reporting engine and its filters.
dependencies.fxRates: Conversion rates per period, synced instead of the static table in Settings.

cases.title: Cases
cases.summary: Post-sale support tickets for accounts and contacts, with SLA tracking.
cases.description: Cases record the support requests that customers raise after a sale: product questions, delivery problems and complaints. Each case is linked to an account and a contact, has a priority and an SLA clock, and moves from new to resolved with a resolution note. Emails to the support address become cases automatically.

capabilities.tickets: Cases linked to an account, a contact and optionally an order
capabilities.priority: Priority, type and owner queue per case
capabilities.sla: SLA clock per priority, with breach warnings
capabilities.emailToCase: Emails to the support address create or update cases

dependencies.email: Email-to-case and replies use the mailbox integration.

automation.title: Automation
automation.summary: Assignment rules, stage-based tasks, alerts and SLA escalation.
automation.description: Automation replaces repetitive manual steps. Assignment rules route new leads by country, group company or round-robin. Stage changes create follow-up tasks. Alerts notify owners about stalled deals. When a lead misses its first-response SLA, it is escalated to the owner's manager.

capabilities.assignmentRules: Lead assignment rules by country, group company and round-robin
capabilities.stageTasks: Tasks created automatically when an opportunity enters a stage
capabilities.alerts: Alerts for stalled deals and overdue tasks
capabilities.slaEscalation: Escalation to the manager when the first-response SLA is missed
capabilities.auditTrail: Every automated change is recorded in the audit log

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.summary: Discount and deal approvals with policies, approvers and history.
approvals.description: Approvals reuse the website's change-request model. A policy defines when approval is needed (for example, a discount above 15% or a deal above an amount) and who approves it. Requests are pending, approved or rejected, with a comment, and approvers work from one inbox. The record stays locked while it waits for approval.

capabilities.policies: Approval policies with conditions on discount, amount and group company
capabilities.approvers: Approvers by user, role or the requester's manager
capabilities.statuses: Pending, approved and rejected states with required comments
capabilities.inbox: One inbox for approvers, with counts in the sidebar
capabilities.history: Full approval history on the record and in the audit log

dependencies.quotes: Quote discounts are the first thing that needs approval.

ai-assistant.title: AI Assistant
ai-assistant.summary: Lead scoring, record summaries, next-best actions and email drafts.
ai-assistant.description: The assistant works on the record page with the Claude API. It scores incoming leads, summarises the history of an account or opportunity, suggests the next best action and drafts emails in the customer's language. It only sees the records the current user can see, and a person reviews every suggestion before anything is saved or sent.

capabilities.leadScoring: Lead score with the reasons behind it
capabilities.summaries: One-paragraph summaries of an account, contact or opportunity
capabilities.nextBestAction: Suggested next step based on stage, activities and similar deals
capabilities.emailDrafts: Email drafts in the customer's language, ready to edit
capabilities.guardrails: Respects record visibility; a person approves every output

dependencies.email: Drafts are sent through the email module and use email history as context.
dependencies.reports: Scoring and suggestions learn from historical won and lost data.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.summary: Website forms and RFQs, ERP, WhatsApp Business and calendars.
integrations.description: Integrations connect the CRM to the systems around it. The website contact and RFQ forms post to the signed inbound endpoint, which is live and still needs to be wired on the website side. The ERP exchanges accounts and orders. WhatsApp Business conversations are logged as activities, and meetings sync with Google and Microsoft calendars.

capabilities.websiteForms: Website contact and RFQ forms create leads through the signed inbound endpoint
capabilities.erp: ERP sync for accounts, orders and invoices
capabilities.whatsapp: WhatsApp Business conversations logged on the timeline
capabilities.calendar: Two-way meeting sync with Google and Microsoft calendars
capabilities.health: Connection status, last sync time and error log per integration

data-import.title: Data Import
data-import.summary: A spreadsheet import wizard with mapping, preview and dedupe.
data-import.description: The import wizard loads leads, accounts and contacts from CSV or Excel files. Users map spreadsheet columns to CRM fields and preview the rows with validation errors highlighted. Duplicates are checked against existing records, and each row is either created, updated or skipped. Every import keeps a log with downloadable error rows.

capabilities.wizard: Step-by-step import of CSV and Excel files
capabilities.mapping: Column-to-field mapping with saved mapping templates
capabilities.preview: Validation preview of every row before anything is written
capabilities.dedupe: Create, update or skip for rows that match existing records
capabilities.importLog: Import history with counts and a file of rejected rows

dependencies.duplicates: Imports use the same matching rules as duplicate management.

duplicates.title: Duplicate Management
duplicates.summary: Matching rules, duplicate alerts and side-by-side merge.
duplicates.description: Duplicate management keeps one record per real customer. Matching rules compare email, and company name with country after normalisation. Users see a warning when they create a likely duplicate. A merge screen shows two records side by side, lets the user pick the value to keep for each field, and moves related activities and opportunities to the surviving record.

capabilities.matchingRules: Matching on email, and on normalised company name with country
capabilities.alertsOnCreate: Duplicate warning when creating or editing a record
capabilities.merge: Side-by-side merge with a field-by-field choice
capabilities.mergeAudit: Merges are recorded in the audit log, with related records moved
